Package com.blukii.sdk.config.datatype

Enum-Klasse SmartPenValueType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SmartPenValueType>
com.blukii.sdk.config.datatype.SmartPenValueType
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Serializable, Comparable<SmartPenValueType>, Constable
public enum SmartPenValueType extends Enum<SmartPenValueType>
This class represents data type SmartPenValueType as part of SmartPenValue

Each SmartPenValue object contains payload bytes and a type that defines what the bytes represent and the length of the data.

Each item in this enum class has a byte value the represents the tag ID of that type, and a length value that represents the length of associated data in bytes.
